key_idea: The after-tax amount x - ceil(x*p/100) is monotone non-decreasing in x, so a max-first Dijkstra on candy counts is valid.
sketch: Run Dijkstra with a max-heap keyed on the number of candies held at each country, relaxing an edge with f(x) = x - ceil(x*p/100). Because f is monotone and f(x) <= x, the greedy extraction order is correct. O(m log n). Pitfalls: ceiling must be computed in integers ((x*p+99)/100), use 64-bit (1e9*100), and do not try to multiply percentages as floats since rounding happens at every border.
